assumptions: The solute is conserved and the volumes add.
Each tube is mixed fully before the next transfer.
limits: Pipetting error compounds down the series and is not modelled.
bio.jane/contract.question: How do I make a dilution series from this stock?

description: Plan a serial dilution: the same fold dilution repeated tube after tube from a stock, each tube made to one volume. Returns the transfer and diluent volumes for every step, each tube's concentration and cumulative dilution, and what each tube holds after giving its transfer to the next.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

fold.description: the dilution at each step, as a fold (1:10 is 10).

stock_concentration.description: concentration of the stock the series starts from.

stock_concentration_unit.description: the unit of the stock concentration, which every tube is reported in.

tube_volume.description: the volume of each dilution after mixing (transfer plus diluent).

tube_volume_unit.description: the unit of the tube volume.

name: plan_serial_dilution

diluent.description: diluent in each tube, in the tube volume's unit

final.description: the last tube's concentration, in the stock's unit

transfer.description: volume moved into each tube, in the tube volume's unit

tubes.description: each tube: step, concentration, cumulative fold, volume left after its transfer
